title: NodeSlide founder roadshow — one founder turns evidence into an investor-ready story
target: A continuous, full-browser story of one founder turning evidence into a six-slide roadshow, directing bounded revisions, verifying provenance, and taking the approved deck to the room.
invariants: No pre-existing deck or seeded product state is used.
Only browser chrome, cursor, and caption overlays may be synthetic.
Every product claim is proven by the visible live UI or the evidence JSON.
Every canonical mutation passes through Compare and explicit Accept.
A required capability that cannot be located stops the recording.
Every proof scene advances the same founder, same deck, and same meeting outcome.

scenes.title: Begin with one founder, one deadline
scenes.proof: Canonical root URL, no query parameters, one dominant composer, and no editor mounted.

scenes.title: Bring the evidence together
scenes.proof: Three visible attachments preserve the PRD, TDD, measured metrics, customer notes, and design direction within NodeSlide's bounded upload limit.

scenes.title: Choose what may leave the browser
scenes.proof: The recommended named model is visible; creation egress is explicitly consented. Web research is separately enabled and consented on the first editor run.

scenes.title: Build the six-slide argument
scenes.proof: A newly generated editor workspace contains exactly six slides.

scenes.title: Keep the story editable
scenes.proof: Text, chart, math, image, and diagram/connector primitives are found in the generated deck.

scenes.title: Direct one precise element change
scenes.proof: The agent proposes a text-only edit scoped to one selected element; the deck remains unchanged.

scenes.title: Review before accepting
scenes.proof: Baseline and candidate are visible together; candidate validation passes before explicit Accept.

scenes.title: Ground one slide with current evidence
scenes.proof: This-slide scope, explicit model consent, separate web-research consent, source capture, Compare, and Accept are visible.

scenes.title: Align the opening chapter
scenes.proof: Two visibly selected slides become the exact write scope; no whole-deck permission is granted.

scenes.title: Clarify the chart without changing evidence
scenes.proof: A source-bound chart label is clarified through the native grid; every numeric value is asserted unchanged, source binding survives, and the canonical version validates.

scenes.title: Refine the north-star formula
scenes.proof: The math expression remains a native editable primitive and the resulting canonical version validates.

scenes.title: Rebalance the approved slide
scenes.proof: A selected element position changes through labeled controls and the resulting canonical version validates.

scenes.title: Replace the image responsibly
scenes.proof: A user-supplied, rights-cleared image, alt text, and credit replace the image primitive and the resulting canonical version validates.
scenes.precondition: Set NODESLIDE_DEMO_IMAGE_PATH to a local PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF whose source and reuse rights are documented.

scenes.title: Audit the accepted work
scenes.proof: Trace shows timestamps, provider/model, tokens/cost, validation, human approval, and claim/element-bound source evidence.

scenes.title: Carry one rule into the next roadshow
scenes.proof: A scoped standing preference is created and enabled for later runs.

scenes.title: Rehearse and share the approved story
scenes.proof: Presenter mode works, then a validated immutable share link is created or shown.

scenes.title: Hand off the editable story
scenes.proof: PowerPoint and validated NodeSlide JSON both download and are hashed in evidence.
